new_terms.definition: The host-wide service mode of Dice. The line `mode: shared` in `/etc/positron/dice.yaml` selects it. Without it Dice runs in legacy mode.
Haskell Program Coverage, the coverage tool of GHC. A program built with it writes a `.tix` file.
The Git hook runner. `lefthook.yml` lists the lint commands that it runs before a commit.
A Google tool, version 1.5. A vendored copy is in `bin/iotools-1.5`.
The build in `gen-coverage` that records which source lines the tests run.

notes: All 24 names are kept. Source was opened for every variable. HTTP_PROXY and HTTPS_PROXY: no TRON code names them outside tests. Python `urllib` and `httpx` read them inside TRON scripts, and `t/proxy/test_rzproxy.py` sets them. The rows use tron_use "reads and sets". The finished ALL_PROXY row of chunk external-01 uses "sets" for the same situation. One of the two choices needs to be applied to all three rows. `bin/ci/hf_cache.py` is a reader for HTTPS_PROXY that the input record did not list. It calls `urllib.request.urlopen` on the GitHub API. These facts come from the Python standard library and not from the checkout: the lower-case proxy names take priority (`urllib.request.getproxies_environment`), and `getpass.getuser()` tries LOGNAME, USER, LNAME, USERNAME in this order. Both were read in Python 3.10.12 on this server. LNAME: no file in the checkout contains the name. The row exists only for the read inside `getpass.getuser()`. It is a candidate for a merge into the LOGNAME row. IOTOOLS_STATIC: it is an internal variable of the vendored iotools makefile. The environment value counts only with STATIC=0. The row is kept for consistency with the ARCHFLAGS row of chunk external-01. GIT_TERMINAL_PROGRESS and LLVM_PARALLEL_LINK_JOBS: `CMakeLists.txt` sets them with `set(ENV{...})`, and no file in the checkout reads them. The rows do not state what git or LLVM does with them. IN_NIX_SHELL: the statement that CMake treats an empty value as set is CMake behaviour of `if(DEFINED ENV{...})`. No line of the checkout shows it. HOME: 23 files outside tests name the variable. The row lists 3 of them. The default cell covers 3 reader groups only. `bin/scratch-dir.sh` replaces an unset value by `/nonexistent` and then makes no scratch mapping. Empty default cells mark rows where TRON only sets the variable, as in chunk external-01. The limit of 35 words for the external section is applied to every effect cell.
